scope: Mount helper fix: only usr/local/sbin/yougori-mount-helper changed in the appliance base, its verified initramfs and the CUDA payload; no user disk, package or other executable changed
reason: Agents from 1.0.16 serve PC-folder and connection shares from /var/lib/yougori/host-shares/, which the helper's source allowlist did not include, so every share mount was refused.

mountHelper.build: scripts/vendor-oci-build/native-compiler.py with the verified private patched musl 1.2.6-r2 toolchain: -static-pie -Os -s -fstack-protector-strong -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now,-z,noexecstack -Wall -Wextra -Werror, as in scripts/build-appliance.sh and build-cuda.sh
mountHelper.reproducibility: The previous source rebuilt with the same command and toolchain reproduced the old helper byte for byte
